passages.note: Co-sponsored the ESA expansion bill as a Representative; the record counts for his current Senate seat because it comes from an earlier term in the same legislature.
Voted Y on House Third Reading of HB2853, a single-subject ESA bill; not near-unanimous (31-26-3-0-0).

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New 15-2401.01 makes any student eligible to attend a public school a qualified student without meeting the other criteria; the 'qualified school' definition (nongovernmental schools, not excluding religious ones) covers clause [b] of rung 5.

rows.reasoning: Kavanagh co-sponsored and voted Y (House Third Reading, 31-26-3-0-0) on HB2853 (2022), a single-subject Arizona empowerment scholarship account bill. New section 15-2401.01 makes any student who 'is eligible to enroll in a public school' a qualified student without needing to meet the chapter's other criteria, and the 'qualified school' definition does not exclude religious schools, matching rung 5's 'universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious.' This record counts for his current Senate seat because it comes from his earlier term in the same legislature's House.
